name: tent
place: Napoleon's campaign tent at night: canvas walls, a wide wooden table with a large map in the middle, a brass lantern hanging from the centre pole above the table, a camp bed against the left wall, the entrance flap in the right wall, a red rug.

napoleon.look: Napoleon Bonaparte as people picture him: a short stout man in a black bicorne hat worn sideways, a dark blue French general's coat with gold epaulettes, a white waistcoat and breeches, tall black riding boots.
napoleon.face: He has a broad square face, a strong straight nose, deep-set dark grey eyes under heavy straight brows, a firm cleft chin, thin pressed lips and short dark hair combed forward.

general.look: An old French general of the Napoleonic wars: a tall plumed bicorne, a blue coat with a red collar and gold braid, white breeches, a sabre at his hip.
general.face: He has a long narrow face, hooded pale eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a large hooked nose, a heavy jaw and a drooping grey moustache.

shots.desc: Napoleon's campaign tent at night: canvas walls, a wide wooden table with a large map in the middle, a brass lantern hanging from the centre pole above the table, a camp bed against the left wall, the entrance flap in the right wall, a red rug. Wide shot from the back of the tent at eye level. Napoleon Bonaparte as people picture him: a short stout man in a black bicorne hat worn sideways, a dark blue French general's coat with gold epaulettes, a white waistcoat and breeches, tall black riding boots. He has a broad square face, a strong straight nose, deep-set dark grey eyes under heavy straight brows, a firm cleft chin, thin pressed lips and short dark hair combed forward. He stands behind the table on the left. An old French general of the Napoleonic wars: a tall plumed bicorne, a blue coat with a red collar and gold braid, white breeches, a sabre at his hip. He has a long narrow face, hooded pale eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a large hooked nose, a heavy jaw and a drooping grey moustache. He stands on the right of the table near the entrance. Both look down at the map.
shots.layout: The camera stands by the camp bed and looks towards the entrance; the entrance is on the right of the picture; the lantern light falls from above.
